ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with approximately 10-15% high-intensity (white) pixel clusters scattered throughout.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant black field with high-contrast white circular rings and irregular punctate clusters distributed across both lobes, with a higher density of white pixels observed in the lower central region and at the distal tips.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 50-60 degrees at the central convergence point.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations with pixel-amplitude peaks ranging from 5 to 20 pixels deep along the entire length of the trailing edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave curvature along the trailing edges terminating in sharp, tapered points at the lateral extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous discrete circular and ring-shaped white pixel clusters (rosettes) distributed across both lobes, consistent with barnacle scar morphology.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned short linear white pixel segments visible on the dark surface of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular ring-shaped scars (rosettes) and irregular white mottling present throughout the ventral surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinctive white 'target' or 'ring' scars scattered primarily on the lower half of the fluke lobes.
